# Brief to Design

> Brief to Design is a free, MIT-licensed Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that makes AI assistants such as Claude Code, Claude.ai, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and Gemini CLI work like a creative director. It turns a brief or notes into a designed PowerPoint (PPTX), HTML slide deck, Word document (DOCX), Markdown notes or landing page. It researches what a name or subject means, explores three visual directions with real colour palettes (Direction Lab), sets a design system, builds the file, then renders every page and fixes defects before delivery.

## Install
- [Install guide for every tool](docs/INSTALL.md): `npx skills add ShivaPrasadNayak/brief-to-design-skill`
